title: Exact standard Gaussian law from complementary linear noise
source_anchor: Canonical library node motivated by pinned openai/math adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a, implementation.tex blob27a4a2ed822eb5d20c33284a3e77f81774bf5cd5, lem:compiler-absorption; SPHMC arXiv2609.06906v1 Algorithm3.1 Gaussian momentum refresh. Neither source theorem is claimed closed by this node.
target_statement: For finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces E,F,G with Borel measurable spaces and continuous linear maps A:E->G,B:F->G, if for every t in G, ||A* t||^2+||B* t||^2=||t||^2, then the pushforward of stdGaussian(E) prod stdGaussian(F) by (x,y)->A x+B y is exactly stdGaussian(G). Independence is the actual product law. No invertibility, full rank of A or B, or nonzero dimension is required.
